s003: The gloved hands gently lift the cat's lip a little further; the cat blinks slowly and its ears twitch. Camera: slow, steady handheld push-in.
s004: The gloved finger holds the lip steady; the cat's tongue shifts slightly and its whiskers twitch, tartar staying clearly visible. Camera: very slow handheld push-in.
s006: The cat chomps down on the brush and tugs its head back as the hand wiggles the brush gently; ears flatten. Camera: subtle handheld shake.
s007: The cat twists its head further away and squirms, ears pinned back, as the brush follows; then the hand pulls the brush back and stops. Camera: slight handheld wobble.
s009: The tub and scoop stay perfectly still, the label readable, while soft light shifts gently across the fleece. Camera: slow, smooth handheld push-in toward the tub.
s010: The cat eats steadily, head dipping slightly as it chews, ears twitching, tail swaying. Camera: subtle handheld drift, slow push-in.
s012: The kitten sniffs the scoop eagerly, nose twitching, and leans closer; the hand holds the scoop steady. Camera: gentle handheld drift with a slight push-in.
s013: The cat rolls slowly from side to side, paws curling, tail swishing; the empty bowl stays still. Camera: subtle handheld drift.
s015: The hand strokes the cat's back slowly as it eats, chewing, ears twitching; the tub stays perfectly still with its label readable. Camera: gentle handheld drift.
s016: The cat lies relaxed, blinking slowly, tail tip flicking, and turns its head toward the tubs; all three tubs stay perfectly still with labels readable. Camera: slow handheld push-in.
s017: The cat finishes rolling onto its back and stretches its paws lazily without touching the tub, tail curling; the tub stays perfectly still with its label readable. Camera: subtle handheld drift.
s018: The cat sniffs around the tub with small head movements, whiskers twitching, without touching it; the tub stays perfectly still with its label readable. Camera: steady overhead handheld, slow push-down.
